newsitem.title: USA: Isco sees FY97 EPS in range of $0.22-$0.24.
newsitem.headline: Isco sees FY97 EPS in range of $0.22-$0.24.

text.p: Isco Inc said Wednesday it expected earnings for fiscal 1997, ending in July, to be in the range of $0.22-$0.24 a share.
The water pollution monitoring equipment maker posted a fiscal 1996 profit of $0.18 a share, including restructuring charges of $1.75 million, on about $40.0 million in sales.

"As a result of the order backlog and the strength of the current order rate, we anticipate sales in excess of $41 million for the full fiscal year," Doug Grant, president and chief operating officer, said in a news release. "Earnings per share are expected to be in the range of $.22 to $.24 per share."
Grant also said that cost reductions from the 1996 restructuring will be less than anticipated, as the company evaluates staffng needs and makes investments in rebuilding the organization.
The company initally predicted annual cost savings of $1.7 million to $1.9 million from the restructuring.
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported net income of $463,000, or $0.09 a share for the third quarter, compared to $588,000, or $0.11 a share a year ago.
